artifacts.text: Pitfall: SIGKILL/power loss leaves a stale 0600 socket inside the 0700 dir; restart therefore needs unlink-before-bind, but unconditional unlink lets a second broker instance steal a still-live peer's path (split-brain auth brokers serving different state). Guard bind with an exclusive flock/pidfile in the same dir, not the socket file itself. Canary oracle (synthetic fixture only): tmpdir 0700 → start broker A on socket → canary curl returns sentinel OK → `kill -9` A → start broker B on same path → assert B binds and canary returns OK → while B alive, start B2 → assert B2 exits non-zero and B's socket still answers. No host scans, no real git/auth state.
